info.description: Fine-grained theme color and corner-radius overrides, for sites that need more control than the basic tokens in Ajustes básicos

edit.label: Secondary color
edit.description: A less prominent brand color, used sparingly by a few components.

edit.label: Muted color
edit.description: Low-emphasis text — captions and secondary copy across the site.

edit.label: Danger color
edit.description: Errors and destructive actions across the site.

edit.label: On-primary color
edit.description: Text/icon color placed on top of the primary color (e.g. button labels).

edit.label: Border color
edit.description: Dividers and outlines used by every component.

edit.label: Extra small radius
edit.description: Corner rounding for the smallest elements (e.g. tags, chips).

edit.label: Small radius
edit.description: Corner rounding for compact elements (e.g. inputs, small buttons).

edit.label: Large radius
edit.description: Corner rounding for large surfaces (e.g. cards, panels).
